messages.content: How is the air quality in Los Angeles right now?

function.name: plant_biomass
function.description: Calculate the biomass of a plant species in a given area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

species_name.description: The name of the plant species.

area.description: The area of the forest in square kilometers. This is a float type value.

density.description: The density of the plant species in the area. Default is average global density. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time air‑quality data. However, I can share general information about typical air‑quality conditions in Los Angeles and explain how you can check the current status yourself.
message.reasoning: The user asks about current air quality in Los Angeles. We need to provide real-time data. According to policy, we cannot provide real-time data unless we have a tool. There's no tool for real-time air quality. So we must refuse or say we don't have real-time data. We can offer to provide general info about typical air quality or how to check. According to policy, we should not fabricate. So we should respond with a refusal or partial compliance. We can say we don't have real-time data but can give general info. That is allowed.
